{{Achievement|All the Gold in Brooklyn|jpg|On the Brooklyn Bank Job escape with at least 12 bags of gold on the Very Hard Difficulty or above. Unlocks the "[[Masks (Payday 2)#Normal (Achievement)|Alces]]" mask and the "[[Masks (Payday 2)#Normal (Achievement)|Canis Lupus]]" mask.}}
{{Achievement|Obsessive Opening|jpg|On the Brooklyn Bank Job open at least 30 deposit boxes and all 3 ATMs on the Overkill difficulty or above. Unlocks the "[[Masks (Payday 2)#Normal (Achievement)|Felis Lynx]]" mask and the "[[Masks (Payday 2)#Normal (Achievement)|Ursus Maritimus]]" mask.}}
{{Achievement|Animal Kingdom|jpg|On the Brooklyn Bank job, complete the heist while you and your four man crew are wearing one different Brooklyn Bank animal mask each on OVERKILL difficulty or above.}}
